evals.prompt: Create a simple academic paper template in Typst called 'paper.typ'. It should have a title, author, abstract, and two column layout. Include some placeholder text.
evals.expected_output: A .typ file with a two column academic layout.

evals.prompt: Write a short document 'math_notes.typ' explaining the quadratic formula. Set the page size to a5, use a serif font, and make all level 1 headings centered and blue.
evals.expected_output: A .typ file with custom page size, fonts, and blue centered headings.

evals.prompt: Using the CeTZ package, draw a simple flowchart in 'flowchart.typ' that shows 'Start' -> 'Process' -> 'End'.
evals.expected_output: A .typ file containing a CeTZ drawing block.
